trace.body:
## Story

- As a **Merchant**, I want **to export my visible settlements to CSV** so that **I can reconcile payouts in my own accounting tool**

## Scenario Claim

- Scenario: Merchant exports visible settlements to CSV

<details>
<summary>Claimed scenarios — synced from Feature #23 — edit there, not here</summary>

```gherkin
Scenario: Merchant exports visible settlements to CSV
  Given the merchant is viewing a list of settlements
  When the merchant clicks the Export button
  Then a CSV file is downloaded containing the visible settlements
  And the filename includes today's date
```

</details>

## Spine Position

- Position: Extension
- Builds on: Trace #21 (Skeleton — settlement list rendering)

## Contracts & Interfaces

GET /settlements/export response:
- Content-Type: text/csv
- Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="settlements-<date>.csv"

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Export button renders in SettlementList component
- [ ] Clicking the button triggers a file download
- [ ] CSV filename includes today's date
- [ ] Unit test covers the button render and click handler
- [ ] System releasable after merge

feature.title: 🚀 Feature: Settlement export
feature.body:
## User Stories

### As a Merchant, I want to export my visible settlements to CSV so that I can reconcile payouts in my own accounting tool

```gherkin
Scenario: Merchant exports visible settlements to CSV
  Given the merchant is viewing a list of settlements
  When the merchant clicks the Export button
  Then a CSV file is downloaded containing the visible settlements
  And the filename includes today's date

Scenario: Revoked session cannot export settlements
  Given a merchant session whose token has been revoked
  When the merchant calls the export endpoint
  Then the request is rejected as unauthorized
  And no CSV file is produced
```

## Trace Plan

1. [x] ☄️ Skeleton — settlement list rendering (claims: "Merchant views the settlement list") — Trace #21
2. [ ] ☄️ Add settlement export button (claims: "Merchant exports visible settlements to CSV") — Trace #25
3. [ ] ☄️ Deepening — export authorization failure modes (claims: "Revoked session cannot export settlements") — Trace #26
